title: Overall bacterial reduction in ponds in series

symbols.definition: number of ponds of equal detention time in series (from the printed sentence, not the printed symbol list)

applicability: Overall bacterial reduction in 'n' ponds of equal detention time 't' in series, computed with completely mixed conditions, which gives a conservative design; a commonly used value of Kb for faecal bacteria at 20°C is 2.0 per day.
notes: The printed symbol list is not repeated for this equation; the definitions above are taken from the surrounding printed sentences.
The exponent n is printed outside the closing parenthesis of the denominator.
